name: closing the loop on a requirement
from: A realized requirement that the firm believes it delivered, and a raiser who has not said so. Nobody is unhappy, the work looks finished, and the belief is stable until somebody is asked for money.
to: The requirement verified against its own conditions by a body that did not realize it, and the raiser having agreed they got what they asked for.
cost: Going back to the raiser after the work is done and inviting them to say no — which is the cheapest thing in the world to skip, costs nothing to skip today, and is the only event in the loop that is evidence of anything.
